accessLimitations.fallback: Independently read same-day cached formal CVPR primary page at /tmp/paper-digest-centers-nov06/policy/273f2262c52ee1b63246.txt; it includes Guanglu Song.

resolvedFindings.issue: Source-attempt result caps inherited stale values (1 instead of actual S2/OpenAlex 15); old revalidation dates appeared current.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Current sourceAttempts now preserve actual endpoint caps (15; extra OpenAlex 12 with queryLimits [12,15]) and separate previous revalidation from November 6 revalidation.

resolvedFindings.issue: Parking deployment did not distinguish the separate SMDM-based case-study model from the main LLaDA-based ViLaD planner.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Current reference and evidence paragraph identify separate SMDM training on 3033 command-action pairs for 6 epochs, parking waypoint output and existing downstream planner.

resolvedFindings.issue: Physical test scope and takeover semantics were too generic.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Current limitation names full-size 2019 Lexus RX450h, Autoware.AI/pure-pursuit, proving-ground/test-track environments and participant-unsatisfactory-behavior takeover semantics.

nonBlockingObservations.note: The paper additionally evaluates semantic segmentation; current detection/message description is accurate but not exhaustive.
Current implementation/evaluation uses two vehicles with three views each (Section 5); adding this concrete scale would further improve the limitation field without changing the present claim.

scientificChecks.claim: DAWN predicts compact semantic latent states, not pixel videos
RFWorld: 49.2 to 37.5 ms at 1024 candidates, single RTX3090, rather than an asserted horizon-times-candidate measured speedup
CoSafe mixed ADS DS55.16 to83.00, with VAD deadlock caveat and takeover interface retained
Defer to Plan DS77.15 to79.72 and RC92.34 to91.05
CooperScene0.2m is matched-point RMSE after another ICP, not global localization error
PRBI79.4/81.0/86.9 are recovered AP loss in n5/k2 V2VNet
scientificChecks.result: supported; result paragraph is more precise than abstract wording

scientificChecks.claim: IEDD LoRA L4 counterfactual reasoning4.66 to0.19
World Engine200km is reported deployment evidence, not rare-event rate estimation
V2VNet/LMDrive/AgentThink author lists can differ by version
scientificChecks.result: Formal ECVA, CVPR and ACL lists checked; preserved formal author lists are justified.

scientificChecks.claim: OmniDreams public post-training sample and FlashDreams inference migration
